stale_reason: Stale at the macOS drills (2026-11-15): the files it was bound to changed

receipts.method: Red drill MAC-00C-linux-import-sound on the owner's MacBook Pro (macOS 15.7.9 24G830, Intel x86_64), launched from here over ssh and run in his signed-in Aqua session by docs/delivery/reports/m1a/mac/aqua.sh (a one-shot launchd job in gui/503) with job.sh's drills step: tests/drills/run.py, with Homebrew's Python 3.13.7, PyQt6 6.11.0 and pytest 9.2.0 in a venv of its own (packaging/requirements-test.txt, hash-locked; reports/m4b/mac/context-observed-aqua.txt), in a temporary copy of 3586a0d's files (git archive). Green (all 8 modules import); then chatmon/sound.py got a top-level 'from select import epoll', a name only Linux's select has, and test_it_imports_here[sound] failed (1 failed, 7 passed) with "ImportError: cannot import name 'epoll' from 'select'" in the fresh interpreter's stderr; the file's bytes were put back (SHA-256 checked) and all 8 passed again. The same drill on chatmon/libdbus.py (reports/m4b/mac/drills-first.log) went green, red and green too, but libdbus.py isn't among AC-00C's task's files, so this receipt drills sound.py, which is.

Red drill MAC-01D-conflict-unreported on the owner's MacBook Pro (macOS 15.7.9 24G830, Intel x86_64), launched from here over ssh and run in his signed-in Aqua session, where Carbon's RegisterEventHotKey reaches the window server, by docs/delivery/reports/m1a/mac/aqua.sh (a one-shot launchd job in gui/503) with job.sh's drills step: tests/drills/run.py, with Homebrew's Python 3.13.7, PyQt6 6.11.0 and pytest 9.2.0 in a venv of its own, in a temporary copy of 3586a0d's files (git archive). Green; then in _Carbon.grab the eventHotKeyExistsErr branch returned None instead of the conflict, and test_macos_reports_a_conflict_and_keeps_the_shortcut_it_had failed at tests/test_hotkey.py:281 ("assert None == 'Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F18 is already used by another app. Pick another shortcut.'"), with Command+Option+Shift+F18 held exclusively by the test itself; the file's bytes were put back (SHA-256 checked) and it passed again. Afterwards Command+Option+Shift+F17, F18 and F19 could each be registered exclusively again (reports/m4b/mac/hotkeys-free.txt).

Red drill MAC-02F-volume-unset on the owner's MacBook Pro (macOS 15.7.9 24G830, Intel x86_64), launched from here over ssh and run in his signed-in Aqua session by docs/delivery/reports/m1a/mac/aqua.sh (a one-shot launchd job in gui/503) with job.sh's drills step, the Mac's output muted throughout: tests/drills/run.py, with Homebrew's Python 3.13.7, PyQt6 6.11.0 and pytest 9.2.0 in a venv of its own, in a temporary copy of 3586a0d's files (git archive). Green; then MacPlayer.play's setVolume: on the NSSound was left out, and test_nssound_plays_at_the_volume failed at tests/test_sound.py:267 ("assert 1.0 == 0.5 ± 5.0e-07": NSSound's own volume, not the one asked for); the file's bytes were put back (SHA-256 checked) and it passed again.
